data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40 vs Azimut 39 for your Marbella yacht charter? All three depart from Puerto Banús, carry 9–11 passengers and come fully crewed with drinks and snacks included. But they differ in style, performance and price. This guide breaks down the specs, capacity and best use cases so you can pick the right boat for your group without guesswork.

We operate all three vessels directly — no third-party listings. That means you get the same all-inclusive service (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, VAT) whether you choose the sporty Pershing, the family-friendly Astondoa or the versatile Azimut. Read on for the full comparison.

Specs at a Glance: Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40 vs Azimut 39

Pershing 46: The Sporty Performer

The Pershing 46 is the only true express cruiser in this trio. At 14 metres, it’s slightly longer than the other two and designed for speed and style. With a sleek, aggressive profile and powerful engines, it can reach 38–40 knots — ideal if you want to feel the wind in your hair as you cruise past the Marbella coastline.

It carries up to 10 passengers, making it a good fit for a group of friends or a couple celebrating a special occasion. The cockpit is open and sporty, with a sunpad aft and a helm station that puts you in control (under the skipper’s supervision, of course). The downside? Less shaded seating compared to the flybridge Astondoa. And pricing is on request — you’ll need to WhatsApp us for a quote.

Astondoa 40: The Family-Friendly Flybridge

The Astondoa 40 is the most traditional of the three, with a flybridge that offers panoramic views and a second helm station. At 12.5 metres, it’s compact but cleverly laid out, with a generous bow sunpad and a shaded cockpit with dining table. It takes up to 9 passengers — perfect for a family with kids or a small group that values comfort over speed.

It’s part of our Tier A pricing, so you know exactly what you’ll pay: €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,799 for 6 hours, or €2,299 for 8 hours. All inclusive. If you want a relaxed day anchoring at Cabopino or cruising to Estepona, the Astondoa 40 is a solid choice.

Azimut 39: The Versatile Group Cruiser

The Azimut 39 is the same length as the Astondoa (12.5 m) but carries the most passengers: 11. That extra capacity comes from its open, uncluttered deck layout. The cockpit is spacious, with a large U-shaped seating area and a sunpad forward. It’s a versatile cruiser that works equally well for a corporate outing, a birthday celebration, or a group of friends.

Like the Astondoa, it’s Tier A pricing: €749/2h, €1,299/4h, €1,799/6h, €2,299/8h. The ride is smooth and stable, and the skipper will take you anywhere from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande or Calahonda. If your group is 10 or 11, this is the most cost-effective option.

Price Comparison: Tier A vs On Request

This is the biggest difference between the three boats. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are both Tier A, meaning fixed, transparent pricing with no hidden fees. The Pershing 46 is not in Tier A or Tier B — pricing is on request via WhatsApp. That doesn’t mean it’s more expensive; it depends on the season and duration. But if you want instant booking, go with the Astondoa or Azimut.

All three include the same inclusions: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment and 21% Spanish IVA. No extras to worry about.

Which Boat for Which Occasion?

  • Pershing 46: Best for a sporty, high-performance day out with up to 10 friends. Great for Instagram-worthy photos and a thrill ride.
  • Astondoa 40: Best for families or small groups who want a comfortable, shaded flybridge experience. Ideal for a relaxed lunch at sea.
  • Azimut 39: Best for larger groups (up to 11) who want an open, social deck. Perfect for parties, celebrations or corporate events.

If you’re still unsure, contact us via WhatsApp — we’ll help you match the boat to your group size and vibe.

Frequently asked questions

Which boat is fastest: Pershing 46, Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39?

The Pershing 46 is the fastest of the three, with a top speed around 38–40 knots thanks to its sporty hull and powerful engines. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are more cruising-oriented, typically cruising at 20–25 knots. If speed matters, go with the Pershing.

Can I book the Pershing 46 online at a fixed price?

No. Unlike the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, which are Tier A boats with transparent pricing (€749/2h to €2,299/8h), the Pershing 46 is priced on request. You need to contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote based on the season and duration you need.

Which yacht is best for a large group of 11 people?

The Azimut 39 is the only one of the three that can take 11 passengers (plus skipper). The Pershing 46 takes 10, and the Astondoa 40 takes 9. If you have exactly 11, the Azimut 39 is your best fit.

Is the Pershing 46 more luxurious than the Astondoa 40?

Both are high-end, but in different ways. The Pershing 46 is a sporty, design-led express cruiser with premium finishes and a focus on performance. The Astondoa 40 offers a more traditional flybridge layout with ample sunbathing and shaded areas. Luxury is subjective, but the Pershing feels more exclusive while the Astondoa is more family-oriented.

Do all three boats include a skipper, fuel and drinks?

Yes – every charter from our fleet includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment and Spanish IVA (21%). So whichever you choose, you get the same all-inclusive service.

Which boat is better for a calm, leisurely day on the water?

The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are better suited for relaxed cruising. They have more shaded cockpit space, comfortable seating and a steadier ride. The Pershing 46 is more dynamic and can feel sportier, which some groups love, but it’s not as laid-back.

Can I take the Pershing 46 to Cabopino or Estepona?

Absolutely. All three boats can cruise to Cabopino (about 15–20 minutes from Puerto Banús) or Estepona (30–40 minutes). The Pershing 46 will get you there faster, but the experience is equally enjoyable on any of them.

How do I book the Pershing 46 if the price isn't listed?

Just send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, duration and number of guests. We'll get back to you with a personalised quote. For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, you can book directly online at the fixed Tier A prices.
